answer: Problem: farms spawn silent clones that copy one successful vote path. Mechanism: each new pubkey must grow a willow ring of 4 live sponsors who each post a whisper-channel commitment for 40 hours before any summit seat can open; the ring samples one sponsor at random every 11 minutes so scripts cannot pre-bind all four. Cost: 0.35% of spendable locked per sponsor until finality. Verify: explorer lists ring_txid plus four distinct sponsor seals. Fail: a dropped whisper or reused ring graph slashes 45% of the lock and bars the key for 3 epochs.
